verses: The day Mow-shin was lucky found; Then to the sire of steeds we prayed. Our cars and teams and gear were good; We scour the heights where wild game strayed.
And Keng-wu also lucky proved; We picked our steeds, and chose our ground,-- Where stags and does by Ts'eih and Ts'eu Made sport for him whom Heaven had crowned.
We viewed the plain where teeming game Now shivering stand, now frantic run; Here two, there three. We charged along, Pleasure to yield to Heaven's great son.
We bend our bows; our shafts we grasp; There lies the huge behemoth low, And boars are pierced:--spoil for the guests, At court, when wine cups overflow.
